PersonalTrainer.title: PersonalTrainer
PersonalTrainer.description: Represents a personal trainer who uses the ElevateFit platform to manage students and workouts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PersonalTrainer entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the personal trainer.

lastName.description: The last name of the personal trainer.

email.description: The email address of the personal trainer, used for communication.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the trainer account was created.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student client managed by a personal trainer on the ElevateFit platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

personalTrainerId.description: Reference to the PersonalTrainer managing this student. (Relationship: PersonalTrainer 1:N Student)

firstName.description: The first name of the student.

lastName.description: The last name of the student.

email.description: The email address of the student, used for communication.

currentWeightKg.description: The current weight of the student in kilograms.

goals.description: A description of the student's fitness goals.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the student profile was created.

Exercise.title: Exercise
Exercise.description: Represents a single exercise available in the ElevateFit exercise database.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Exercise entity.

name.description: The name of the exercise (e.g., 'Bench Press').

description.description: A detailed description of how to perform the exercise.

videoUrl.description: Optional URL to an instructional video for the exercise.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL to an image demonstrating the exercise.

WorkoutPlan.title: WorkoutPlan
WorkoutPlan.description: Represents a custom training program designed by a trainer for a specific student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutPlan entity.

personalTrainerId.description: Reference to the PersonalTrainer who created this plan. (Relationship: PersonalTrainer 1:N WorkoutPlan)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student to whom this plan is assigned. (Relationship: Student 1:N WorkoutPlan)

name.description: The name of the workout plan (e.g., 'Strength Cycle - Week 1').

description.description: An optional description or objective for the workout plan.

startDate.description: The date when the workout plan is scheduled to start.

endDate.description: The date when the workout plan is scheduled to end.

assignedDate.description: The date and time when the workout plan was assigned to the student.

WorkoutPlanExercise.title: WorkoutPlanExercise
WorkoutPlanExercise.description: Details a specific exercise included in a workout plan, including sets, reps, and rest time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutPlanExercise entity.

workoutPlanId.description: Reference to the WorkoutPlan this exercise belongs to. (Relationship: WorkoutPlan 1:N WorkoutPlanExercise)

exerciseId.description: Reference to the Exercise being performed. (Relationship: Exercise 1:N WorkoutPlanExercise)

sets.description: The number of sets prescribed for this exercise.

reps.description: The number of repetitions prescribed per set for this exercise.

restTimeSeconds.description: The prescribed rest time in seconds between sets for this exercise.

orderIndex.description: The sequential order of this exercise within the workout plan.

WorkoutSession.title: WorkoutSession
WorkoutSession.description: Represents a specific instance of a student performing a workout, potentially from an assigned plan, on a given date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutSession entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who performed this workout session. (Relationship: Student 1:N WorkoutSession)

workoutPlanId.description: Reference to the WorkoutPlan this session is part of. Can be null if it's an ad-hoc session. (Relationship: WorkoutPlan 1:N WorkoutSession)

sessionDate.description: The date and time when the workout session was performed or scheduled.

notes.description: General notes about the workout session provided by the student or trainer.

status.description: The status of the workout session (e.g., 'completed', 'skipped', 'in_progress', 'scheduled').

WorkoutExerciseLog.title: WorkoutExerciseLog
WorkoutExerciseLog.description: Records the performance details for a single set of an exercise within a student's workout session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutExerciseLog entity.

workoutSessionId.description: Reference to the WorkoutSession this exercise log belongs to. (Relationship: WorkoutSession 1:N WorkoutExerciseLog)

exerciseId.description: Reference to the Exercise that was performed. (Relationship: Exercise 1:N WorkoutExerciseLog)

setNumber.description: The sequential number of the set performed (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

repsCompleted.description: The number of repetitions completed for this set.

weightLiftedKg.description: The weight lifted in kilograms for this set.

restTimeTakenSeconds.description: The rest time taken in seconds before starting this set (optional, might be per set or per exercise).

notes.description: Optional notes specific to this exercise performance (e.g., 'struggled on last rep').

ProgressMetric.title: ProgressMetric
ProgressMetric.description: Records various numerical progress metrics for a student over time, such as weight.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProgressMetric entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student for whom this metric is recorded. (Relationship: Student 1:N ProgressMetric)

dateRecorded.description: The date and time when the metric was recorded.

value.description: The numerical value of the recorded metric.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the metric (e.g., 'kg', '%', 'cm').

notes.description: Optional notes related to this metric recording.

ProgressPhoto.title: ProgressPhoto
ProgressPhoto.description: Records progress photos for a student over time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProgressPhoto entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student for whom this photo was taken. (Relationship: Student 1:N ProgressPhoto)

dateTaken.description: The date and time when the photo was taken.

imageUrl.description: The URL to the stored progress photo.

notes.description: Optional notes related to this progress photo.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Stores notifications sent to trainers or students within the app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

recipientId.description: Reference to the ID of the recipient (PersonalTrainer or Student). (Relationship: PersonalTrainer/Student 1:N Notification)

senderId.description: Reference to the ID of the sender (PersonalTrainer or Student), or null if system-generated. (Relationship: PersonalTrainer/Student 1:N Notification)

message.description: The content of the notification message.

notificationType.description: The category or type of notification (e.g., 'workoutAssigned', 'workoutCompleted', 'generalAlert').

isRead.description: Indicates whether the recipient has read the notification.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the notification was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for ElevateFit prioritizes **Authorization Independence** by rigorously applying hierarchical paths and denormalization. All data belonging to a `PersonalTrainer` or one of their `Student`s is nested under the corresponding user's path. This strategy ensures that Firebase Security Rules can authorize requests by simply comparing `request.auth.uid` with the wildcard in the path (`{personalTrainerId}` or `{studentId}`) without resorting to expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents. This atomic authorization drastically simplifies rule writing and improves debugging.

For example, a student's `WorkoutPlan` is located at `/personalTrainers/{personalTrainerId}/students/{studentId}/workoutPlans/{workoutPlanId}`. A security rule can directly check `request.auth.uid == personalTrainerId` or `request.auth.uid == studentId` to grant access. The document itself also includes `personalTrainerId` and `studentId` fields (denormalization) for data integrity and flexible querying (e.g., retrieving all plans for a specific student without knowing the trainer in advance, by using a collection group query on `workoutPlans` and filtering by `studentId`).

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters)** are primarily supported through **Structural Segregation**. Instead of mixing public and private data, or data for different users, all documents within a given collection path share the same security posture. For instance, all documents in `/personalTrainers/{personalTrainerId}/students/{studentId}/workoutPlans` are workout plans for that specific student, managed by that specific trainer. This means that a `list` operation on this path will only return documents that the authenticated user is authorized to see, eliminating the need for client-side filtering and ensuring that all results adhere to security rules. Notifications are also segregated into trainer-specific and student-specific paths to ensure that users only query for and receive notifications relevant to them and authorized by their role and ownership.

The `exercises` collection is a global, shared resource, accessible by all authenticated trainers, representing a common, homogeneous security posture for that data type.

This design leverages explicit state modeling (e.g., `status` field for `WorkoutSession`) and radical consistency in naming conventions (e.g., `{personalTrainerId}`, `{studentId}`) to enhance clarity and predictability for both developers and security rule authors.
